title: DevOps
description: A step-by-step path to learn DevOps: Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD and Kubernetes, with the best free resources for each step.
intro: DevOps brings the people who build software and the people who run it closer together, so that new features reach users faster and with fewer surprises.
This roadmap lists the skills in the order that makes learning easiest. For each topic you get a short list of resources, with a reason why each one is worth your time.

faq.question: Do I need to know programming to start DevOps?
faq.answer: Basic scripting helps a lot, but you can begin with Linux and Git first and learn scripting along the way.

faq.question: How long does it take to learn DevOps?
faq.answer: Most beginners need several months of steady practice to cover the basics. Building small projects speeds this up.
